Read in the judgment and deliberately not admitted. (1) Coconut Grove Beach Resort and Conference Centre Ltd, named by the court as a shareholder of GN and a member of Groupe Nduom: the scope rule of 4 September 2026 admits a non-S&L node only where a scoped institution's own notice names it, and it is not widened for one leaf. (3) An assignment of receivables of GHS 629,091,335 to GN (pp.14-15): evidence on the value of GN's assets, the question under appeal. (4) A capital deficit of GHS 344.46 million in the Bank of Ghana's affidavit, against GHS 683.66 million in its notice: a solvency figure, recorded and not reconciled. GN is the one institution where the latest decision found the revocation unjustified, and adding its chairman to a graph of insider relationships behind the failures would imply a conclusion that decision cuts against.
